opening_posts.content: From 1 June, motorised delivery e-scooters are banned from sidewalks and shared paths. 212 pedestrians were injured last year. Riders will use road lanes; 40 km of protected lanes will follow. Fines start at $150.
We asked for this after too many of our members were hurt. Thank you. Now enforce it quickly.

injections.content: Two councillors privately question whether the promised 40 km of protected lanes is funded, the Courier has learned.
injections.why: tests whether the unfunded-lanes framing takes over (F7)
